The Senate confirmed Trump's personal lawyer as Attorney General of the United States. The man who defended Trump in criminal court, who mishandled the Epstein files release, who met with Ghislane Maxwell in secret, who created a slush fund to pay off political allies, and who gave Trump immunity. That guy will now run the Department of Justice.
